messages:
Anna (CFO): Thanks everyone for the Q&A today. Quick thread to capture follow-ups and clarifications from the all-hands about burn, spend controls, and procurement. I'll answer and @assign action items here. TL;DR: runway ~20 months on our base forecast; new spend guardrails go into effect immediately.

Liam (Eng): Quick Q — is there still a hiring pause for ICs?

Anna (CFO): No full hiring freeze. We have a limited headcount hold for non-critical roles. Customer-facing, infra, and SRE hires are prioritized. If you're unsure about a req, escalate to your manager and cc finance.

Priya (PM): Can you share the updated approval matrix?

Lisa (Finance Ops): Posting the matrix below (effective immediately):

```
approval_thresholds (effective 2026-03-23)
< $2,500 — Team lead approval
$2,500 - $25,000 — Manager + Finance Ops
$25,000 - $100,000 — Finance Ops + VP
>= $100,000 — CFO approval + Procurement
```

Priya (PM): Does procurement include international vendors? Especially APAC cloud contracts.

Anna (CFO): Yes. For foreign vendors we need tax/residency checks and the regional procurement lead to sign off. Use the vendor intake form (link below) — finance will fast-track infra/cloud spend where we have standing contracts.

Elaine (People Ops): For contractor extensions (T&M), do they follow the same thresholds?

Lisa (Finance Ops): They do, with one note: contractor renewals under $10k/month can be approved by Eng manager + People Ops if the role is scoped and budgeted. Anything above that follows the normal matrix.

Jamal (CEO): One operational allowance — we will allow one-time growth experiments up to $50k with a short memo: objective, metrics, and sunset plan. These require VP + Finance Ops sign-off.

Liam (Eng): Any change to credit card / expense policy? Ran into a vendor who wouldn’t accept invoices because PO missing last week.

Lisa (Finance Ops): New rule: vendor-facing POs required for commitments > $5k before signing an SOW. Temporary exceptions: cloud metered billing and marketplace subscriptions. If you hit a vendor roadblock, tag #procurement and @Lisa.

Lisa (Finance Ops): Vendor onboarding checklist (short):

```
Vendor onboarding checklist:
- W9/W8 form (tax)
- Signed PO template (if > $5k)
- Security questionnaire (if infra/hosted service)
- GL code assigned + cost center
```

Priya (PM): Where is the vendor intake form?

Lisa (Finance Ops): https://rwd.ai/forms/vendor-intake — fill that first, it auto-routes to finance and procurement.

Lisa (Finance Ops): Action: publish updated PO template + vendor intake link in Confluence and #procurement. Owner: Lisa. ETA: EOD today.

Anna (CFO): Action: I'll share a sanitized headcount impact model with managers by Friday so teams can plan.

Priya (PM): Can you confirm the runway math again? Numbers in the chat were a bit fast.

Anna (CFO): Sure — current gross cash burn: ~$3.2M/month. With committed ARR and current reserves, our base-case runway is ~20 months. Conservative scenario (assume a 3–5% ARR slowdown) compresses to ~14 months. We'll publish the spreadsheet and assumptions in the finance folder.

Priya (PM): OK, thanks :thumbsup: 

DevProcBot: New policy doc uploaded: /docs/finance/spend-guardrails-2026-03-23

Elaine (People Ops): For managers — any change to travel budgets? We had a few trips already approved this quarter.

Anna (CFO): Travel budgets temporarily reduced by 25% for the next two quarters. Exceptions for sales/customer travel require VP approval. Any already-approved travel that’s >25% over new guideline needs a quick re-review.

Liam (Eng): Are we adjusting infra reserved capacity (Dedicated) commitments? Curious if that’s where we expect most savings.

Anna (CFO): Infra optimizations are a priority for Redwood Optimize. Expect recommendations this month for right-sizing reserved instances and quantization investments — those should reduce unit costs. We won’t break SLAs; we’re optimizing where utilization is low.

Jamal (CEO): Appreciate the clear rules and the action owners. Keep questions coming here — we'll close this thread once Lisa posts the docs and I see the headcount model.

Lisa (Finance Ops): Noted. I’ll ping this thread when everything is up. :white_check_mark:
